input.summary: Narrow § 12.4 to a mutual twelve (12) month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the Services, with advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire
input.comment: [Playbook] Our preferred position is no non-solicit on us at all, and a 24-month bar on hiring any Vendor employee "regardless of how the employee applies" is a no-hire we cannot accept and conflicts with § 12.3. As a fallback we have made the clause mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in the Services for twelve (12) months after their involvement ends, and carved out general advertisements, unsolicited approaches and hiring.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Neither Party shall solicit the other's personnel directly involved in the Services for twelve (12) months after their involvement ends. General advertisements, unsolicited approaches, and hiring are not restricted.
